title: Love Your LGS 2020: card flavor text

entities.name: Reliquary Tower
entities.description: A tower that, according to Archmage Vintra, is not merely a structure but the community and shared wisdom of its inhabitants, growing upward with a stone for every new arrival.

entities.name: Archmage Vintra
entities.description: An archmage who speaks of the Reliquary Tower as embodying its members and their shared wisdom.

relations.note: Vintra counts herself among those who make up the tower.
relations.quote: It is all of us, and the wisdom we share.
